verses.text: Benjamin's firstborn son was Bela. His second was Ashbel, his third was Aharah,
his fourth was Nohah, and his fifth was Rapha.
Bela's sons were Addar, Gera, Abihud,
Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
These were the descendants of Ehud, the heads of the families living in Geba, who were forced to move to Manahath:
Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. Gera led them when they moved, and he was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
Shaharaim had children in the country of Moab after he had sent away his wives Hushim and Baara.
By his wife Hodesh he had Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, and they were heads of families.
By Hushim he had Abitub and Elpaal.
Elpaal's sons were Eber, Misham, and Shemed. Shemed built Ono and Lod and their villages.
Beriah and Shema were heads of the families living in Aijalon. They drove out the people of Gath.
Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were Beriah's sons.
Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were Elpaal's sons.
Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,
Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were Shimei's sons.
Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,
Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
Iphdeiah, and Penuel were Shashak's sons.
Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri were Jeroham's sons.
All these were heads of families, as listed in their family records. They were leaders, and they lived in Jerusalem.
Jeiel, the father of Gibeon, lived in Gibeon. His wife was named Maacah.
His firstborn son was Abdon. His other sons were Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
and Mikloth, who was the father of Shimeah. They also lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.
Ner was the father of Kish. Kish was the father of Saul. Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
Jonathan's son was Merib-Baal. Merib-Baal was the father of Micah.
Micah's sons were Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri was the father of Moza.
Moza was the father of Binea. Binea's son was Raphah, Raphah's son was Eleasah, and Eleasah's son was Azel.
Azel had six sons. Their names were Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were Azel's sons.
The sons of his brother Eshek were Ulam, his firstborn, Jeush, his second, and Eliphelet, his third.
Ulam's sons were brave warriors who could shoot with bows. They had many sons and grandsons, one hundred and fifty in all. All these were descendants of Benjamin.
